class.name: HordeType
class.brief_description: Shared settings for one kind of [Horde2D] agent: look, body and movement.
class.description: A [HordeType] describes a kind of agent (an enemy type, a critter...). Pass it to [method Horde2D.spawn] or [method Horde2D.spawn_ring]; every agent spawned with it shares these settings. The same resource can be used by several [Horde2D] nodes. Changes to the movement and body properties apply to living agents on the next update. [member max_hp] is only read when an agent spawns (and as the cap when healing with a negative [method Horde2D.damage]). Agents are drawn with [member texture] at its native size: [member radius] only sets the body used for separation, obstacles, queries and contacts, so pick a radius that matches the visible sprite. [codeblock] var zombie := HordeType.new() zombie.texture = preload("res://zombie_walk.png") # 4 frames side by side. zombie.hframes = 4 zombie.fps = 8.0 zombie.radius = 6.0 zombie.max_speed = 90.0 $Horde2D.spawn(zombie, Vector2(400, 0), 50) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_frame_size
method.description: Returns the size in pixels of one animation frame: the [member texture] width divided by [member hframes], and its height. Without a texture, returns the body diameter ([code]2 * radius[/code], at least 1).

members.member: Maximum change of velocity per second, in pixels per second squared. High values make agents turn and stop almost instantly; low values make them drift.
Animation speed in frames per second. Every agent starts at a random frame, so a horde does not animate in lockstep. With [code]0[/code], each agent keeps showing the frame it was given at spawn.
Number of animation frames laid out side by side in [member texture]. Only horizontal strips are supported.
Hit points an agent has when it spawns. An agent dies when [method Horde2D.damage] or [method Horde2D.damage_circle] brings it to [code]0[/code] or below.
Maximum speed in pixels per second.
Color multiplied with the texture of every agent of this type. Without a texture, it is the color of the square drawn for each agent.

Radius of the agent's body in pixels. Used for separation from other agents, obstacles, bounds, [method Horde2D.query_circle], [method Horde2D.damage_circle] and target contacts. It does not scale the sprite.
How strongly agents move towards the [Horde2D] target. [code]0[/code] disables seeking; negative values make agents flee.

How strongly agents steer away from overlapping neighbours. [code]0[/code] makes this type ignore other agents (they still avoid it). The positional push controlled by [member Horde2D.overlap_resolution] also only applies to types with a non-zero weight.
Sprite strip used to draw the agents, with [member hframes] frames side by side. If [code]null[/code], agents are drawn as squares of the body diameter tinted with [member modulate].
